answer: We formalize Sybil resistance via dynamic opportunity-cost bonds mapped across a cryptographic trellis of zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions. An adversary dividing collateral across k identities forfeits baseline yields derived from the liquidity oasis, incurring exponential lockup penalties and triggering a subgame-perfect slashing matrix verified by a lotus state circuit. Because the expected attack utility satisfies E[U] = \sum(\pi_i - B_i - S_i) < 0, the unique Nash equilibrium strictly converges to honest, single-identity participation.
